name: Sudharsan S
status: Open to contract and full-time XR roles
heroStatement: I build spatial software for headsets, phones, and browsers — from hand-tracked VR tools to AR wayfinding and multiplayer WebXR rooms.
bio: I'm an XR developer working across the full stack of spatial computing: real-time rendering, sensor input, and the interaction design that makes a headset feel invisible. Most of my time splits between Unity and native platform SDKs, with a growing interest in bringing full mixed-reality experiences to the open web. I care about frame budgets as much as user flows — a slow app breaks presence faster than a bad idea does.
